meta.title: Sidebar logo
meta.description: Replace the logo in the sidebar's top-left corner with your own artwork, switch the whole row to Claude Code or Codex with a built-in preset, or hide it entirely so everything below moves up. A part you leave blank keeps the shipped DeepSeek artwork, so you can change just the mark or just the wordmark; Hide the mark cell lets a self-contained wordmark image stand alone. Open Settings, then Sidebar logo, to edit; the page previews your edits as you type. Settings are saved in this browser only.
